attempts.summary: Built a 3-member etcd v3.5.17 cluster on node1/node2/node3 (RHEL7) using static binaries, systemd units, and firewalld rules for ports 2379/2380. Verified cross-member reads/writes, availability with one member down, and catch-up on rejoin. Completed the mandatory sequential restart protocol on all three nodes with confirmed boot-id changes and full post-restart cluster/data recovery.
